buyerInputs: Product dimensions, product weight and packed configuration
Packaging structure direction, such as folding carton, rigid gift box, paper tube, clear box, corrugated mailer or paper bag
Logo placement, artwork status, brand colors and version count
Surface finish direction, such as matte, foil, embossing, texture, window or sleeve
Sales channel, including retail, e-commerce, gift set, launch kit or distributor route
Quantity range, destination market and document questions for project-specific review

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Only asks for custom packaging boxes.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Defines the product, packed size, box type, insert need and sales channel before supplier review.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Asks for boxes with logo without artwork details.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Shares logo placement, artwork status, color references and any barcode or label area.
Compares structure fit, sample review quality, material direction, finishing capability, communication clarity and document questions.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Requests a quote before the project brief is complete.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Prepares size, quantity range, structure, material, finish, artwork, sample goal and destination market questions.
